morphology.compounding_rule: Akkadian construct-chains (Bit-[god], Dur-[ruler], Kar-[god], resource + feature) absorbing fitted Sinitic meaning-compounds (quality/feature + type): the capital Hua-shinar (the flower-realm of the river-plain), Dur-Tullaru (fort of Tullaru), Kasap-sheng (the golden city, < jin-cheng).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Akkadian governing line keeps the 'mar-' (son of) patronymic and theophoric constructs; the Sinitic substrate keeps a clan-surname placed first (xing-fitted), but under the throne the construct wins - a Bit- house-name absorbing the old Sinitic xing; order given-first for the Akkadian register, surname-first survives among the cheng-folk.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried ziggurats and fallen warlord cheng: 'the Ziggurat of Dur-[name]', 'the Sunken Ekalbu', 'the Ruined Cheng of [name]', 'the Tomb-Terrace of the Bit-[house]'
patterns.military_units: the Sharru's hari (war-host) and the city-standards and banners: 'the Standard of Urlandu', 'the Azure Banner of Alsheng', 'the Iron-helm Companies'
patterns.ships: river-junks and canal-barges: 'Pride of the Jangu', 'the Jade Dragon', 'Boat of Tullaru'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Akkadian reflexes PRIMARY (family_near_eastern / hammuran morphs: Tullaru, Urlandu, Numunu, Gayandu, Rialtu), Sinitic celestial morphs SECONDARY (family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic: Tuli, Aolan, Numeng, Gaidun, Lianta), never real Mesopotamian/Chinese gods. The Akkadian temple-stele tradition and the Sinitic Mandate-of-Heaven are read as one order: the law-tablet IS the celestial register. All three alignments.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as -lemnu (Akkadian evil) or mo (Sinitic demon-marshals), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marakshu the City-Burner (Sin Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Bakidu-lemnu the Unmaking (Sin Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusanu the Coin-Serpent (Sin Lusan).

holy_symbol_motifs.Gayandu: the alluvial grain-field beneath the ziggurat and the green mountain
holy_symbol_motifs.Tullaru: a winged sun-disc above the law-stele and the seal of office
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlandu: an iron sword crossed with the city-standard and the war-banner

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Bit-ili (Akkadian god-house) or Miao (fitted Sinitic temple) of [power]: 'the Bit-ili of Tullaru', 'the Miao of Tuli'; the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine) for the zu beneath the temple-stele.
religion.saints_pattern: deified law-givers and worthy officials enrolled both on the temple-stele and in the celestial register, honored at the ziggurat-terrace, the Ci (ancestral shrine), and the Miao; 'the Just [name]' / 'the Lord [name]'.

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gayandu (Sin Gaidun) - the enduring earth, lord of mountains and the grain-altar
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numunu (Sin Numeng) - sky and scribe-wisdom, patron of the cuneiform-and-mandarin ministry
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tullaru (Sin Tuli) - the sun and judgment, the Sun-Justice power of the stele and the celestial register

religion.the_one: Itarnu (Akk; Sin Aiteng) - the Highest Heaven and the great distant one, the source of the Mandate, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Itarnu - as the tyrant-gods and the false Mandate to be defied.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Itarnu, Tullaru the just, Urlandu of the sworn war, Rialtu the merciful - filed in the celestial register and inscribed on the law-stele; names the Chaotic powers -lemnu (evil) or mo (demon-marshals), warded; the law-tablet and the Mandate bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral dead (the deified abu of the ruling Bit-houses and the zu-lineages of the cheng) and the local earth-and-grain powers of the bit-ili and the Miao; the great powers invoked at the ziggurat-terrace and the pagoda situationally

titles._tiers_note: Akkadian ladder, ascending, with the Sinitic substrate court-titles beneath. Hazannu (mayor) barony; Massaru (warden) march; Shaknu (appointed governor) county; Turtanu (commander-in-chief) duchy; Rubu (prince) principality; Sharru (king) kingdom over a Sharrutu, who also holds the Mandate (the Tianming, fitted Tinminu); Shar-kishshati (the king-of-the-totality; Akk) emperor over the Kishshatu, the Sinitic huangdi recast as the Akkadian king-of-kings. The absorbed cheng keep their Sinitic dudu (frontier commander) and wang (under-king) as co-titles beneath the Akkadian crown; the mandarin guan (official) and the scribal shatammu staff the one ministry. Rank titles fuse the real Akkadian and Chinese registers (allowed); DISPLAY titles are English.
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (no approved commonly-known foreign term covers a cuneiform-mandarin throne; English display titles used). The *_native conlang forms (Akkadian) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (an Akkadian temple-and-stele bureaucracy over a Sinitic Mandate-realm: the sharru and his rubu-kin at the crown, the shaknu-governors over the alsheng-cities, the scribal-priestly ekallu and the mandarin officialdom folded into one ministry; the sangu-priesthood and the examination-clerk serve the same throne)
titles.heir: Mar-Sharri (son of the king / crown prince; the Akkadian heir-title, the Sinitic Taizi recast)
